start: Menu, Training, Workout plans, signed in as the owner

user_sees: Sheet titled 'New workout plan' with 'Plan name' and 'Days of the plan'
Hint 'No exercises on this day yet. Search below to add one.'
Search box under 'Add an exercise' with the grey words 'Search: bench, squat, dole, chhati…'
must_not: A day that already holds exercises nobody picked

user_sees: Up to 8 rows, each starting '+ ' and the exercise name, then its muscles in words such as 'Chest'
must_not: An empty list for a common gym lift
More than 8 rows pushing the rest of the sheet away
Raw muscle keys such as 'front_delts' in place of words

user_sees: The exercise joins the day with Sets 3, Reps from 8 and Reps to 12
The search box is empty again
must_not: The exercise added twice
The old search words left in the box

user_sees: Biceps exercises are listed, the best match first
must_not: No match for a word the search box itself suggests

steps.action: Type a plan name, choose who gets it and save
user_sees: The plan is in the Workout plans list
must_not: The member's phone making a new exercise for one that is in its own library
A hold exercise sent as weight and reps

start: New workout plan sheet, search box under 'Add an exercise' (an exercise typed by hand)

steps.action: Type 'Sandbag carry', a name that is not in the list
user_sees: A row in the accent colour: '+ Add “Sandbag carry” as your own exercise'
must_not: The row offered when the typed name is exactly a list exercise's name

user_sees: The exercise joins the day with Sets 3, Reps 8 to 12 and a 'Main muscle' picker that says 'Pick one'
must_not: A muscle chosen for the trainer without asking
The exercise saved under a list exercise's key

user_sees: Muscles in plain words: Chest, Lats, Upper back, Inner thighs, Outer thighs, Calves, Cardio and the rest
must_not: A raw key such as 'adductors' in the picker

start: New workout plan sheet, search box under 'Add an exercise'

user_sees: No rows and no 'Add as your own exercise' row
must_not: An exercise with an empty name added

user_sees: No list rows; only '+ Add “zzzzqq” as your own exercise'
must_not: An error, or list rows that do not hold the typed letters

steps.action: Type a name of 200 letters and tap the 'Add' row
user_sees: The row shows the first 80 letters; the exercise is added with a shortened name
must_not: The name cut with no word to the trainer
The sheet stretched sideways by the long name

steps.action: Type 'bench press' when Bench Press is already on the day and tap it again
user_sees: A second Bench Press on the day, or a word that it is already there
must_not: The first Bench Press's sets and reps changed

start: Workout plans, one saved plan holding a list exercise and a hand-typed one

user_sees: Each exercise shows its muscles in words and, where it applies, how it is logged ('Body weight', 'Held for time', 'Machine takes weight off')
must_not: A saved exercise shown with empty muscles because its key is no longer found
The hand-typed exercise turned into a list exercise

steps.action: Tap the red 'Remove' on one exercise, then search and add the same one again
user_sees: The exercise is back with the starting numbers 3 sets of 8 to 12
must_not: The removed exercise's old note or video coming back
Two copies

steps.action: Save, then open the plan again
user_sees: The same exercises in the same order
must_not: A changed log type after saving
